title: Guardrails for trust, safety, and ethical development and deployment of Large Language Models (LLM)
reasoning: The paper proposes a technical framework for guardrail modules (PII, Toxicity, and Prompt Safety) for LLMs. While it frames these as necessary for 'ethical development and deployment,' the paper evaluates technical performance on toxicity and prompt hacking datasets rather than benchmarking moral reasoning, religious content, or ethical frameworks.
